description: This file defines the NvramConfig class and its nested class InstanceSpecific, which manage the configuration of a modem simulator, including methods for initialization, access, and serialization.

classes.name: NvramConfig
classes.description: Manages the overall configuration of the modem simulator, including multiple instances and serialization.

classes.name: NvramConfig::InstanceSpecific
classes.description: Represents configuration details for a specific modem simulator instance.

methods.name: InitNvramConfigService
methods.description: Initializes the NVRAM configuration service with a specified number of instances and simulation type.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current NvramConfig object.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves the current configuration to a file.

methods.name: NvramConfig
methods.description: Constructor for NvramConfig with number of instances and simulation type.

methods.name: ConfigFileLocation
methods.description: Returns the default configuration file location.

methods.name: SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves the configuration to a specified file.

methods.name: ForInstance
methods.description: Returns the configuration for a specific instance.

methods.name: Instances
methods.description: Returns a list of all instances.

methods.name: emergency_mode
methods.description: Checks if emergency mode is enabled.

methods.name: LoadFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a file.

methods.name: BuildConfigImpl
methods.description: Builds a configuration object based on number of instances and simulation type.
